review: Reviewed exact source/Core/Smart pair. The Smart runtime is byte-identical to the previous review. The only change in this pair is one Core token: the light branch of --sf-outline-disable moves from 24% to 80% of neutral-50, matching --sf-on-disable, so a disabled outlined control keeps a visible edge instead of the faintest line on itself. smart-base and the loader are unchanged, and no attribute, property, event, slot, nesting rule, cleanup path or asset reference is touched, so none of the eight lessons changes.
